builder:
Characters Tab

  • Select main/assist characters and set their levels
  • Click potentials to select/deselect and adjust levels
  • Use potential marks (Essential, Recommended, etc.) to organize your build

Records Tab

  • Configure main and sub records
  • Skill effects change based on limit break level

Save/Share

  • Use top-right buttons to save builds or share via URL
  • Check recommended builds in the Presets tab
characterdb:
Character Info

  • Select a character to view detailed information
  • Use the level slider to see stat changes
  • Compare stats across different limit break levels

Potentials & Skills

  • Switch between Main/Assist potentials using tabs
  • Check skill effects at different levels

Archives & Dating

  • View character stories and voice lines
  • Check dating guide for best choices
discdb:
Record Selection

  • Use element filters and search to find records
  • Click a record to view detailed information

Skill Info

  • View main and sub skills
  • Compare skill effects at different limit break levels

Gallery

  • Click record images to enlarge
  • Check the Story tab for background lore
resources:
Character Resources

  • Add characters and set target level/limit break
  • Required materials and stamina are calculated automatically

Record Resources

  • Add records and set target levels
  • Sub record note collection materials are also calculated

Overview

  • Check required resources for all characters/discs at a glance
  • Check badge materials for all characters
tasks:
Task Selection

  • Select up to 4 tasks from the left panel
  • Use filters and search to find specific tasks

Owned Characters

  • Use the Manage Ownership button to set owned characters
  • Only owned characters can be used for auto placement

Character Assignment

  • Click on a task to start selecting and placing characters
  • Task is complete when all tags are filled
